# f5xc_network_policy_view (Data Source)

Network policy site view defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage a volterra site in Network policy.<br>It can be used to either automatically create or Manually assisted site creation in Network policy.<br><br>View will create following child objects.<br><br>* Site

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Network Policy View - Full

data "f5xc_network_policy_view" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_network_policy_view.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_network_policy_view.example.namespace
}
```
